grandparents_cupboard.reason: Oats, milk, natural yoghurt, honey, fruit, seeds and cinnamon are all plain home-kitchen foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including strawberries in season and pumpkin seeds, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a fork and a grater, and mashing and stirring are well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Soaking 200g oats in 300ml milk, 200g yoghurt, orange juice and mashed strawberries is a sound bircher ratio for four, and the morning splash of milk covers any thickness.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers hulling the strawberries, zesting and juicing an orange and stirring, and the 480 unattended minutes match the overnight soak.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the cinnamon and mint, appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used apart from a splash of the listed milk.

seasonal_feel.reason: A cool strawberry bircher suits the end of May, and the strawberries are both mashed through and piled on top, so they are clearly the point.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and plainly British in tone, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oats, yoghurt, milk, fruit and seeds make a filling breakfast with only a tablespoon of honey for four.
